response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with 13+ years across web, mobile, embedded and high-performance backend systems, strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD, DevOps) and excellent communication skills evidenced by workshops and conference talks. However, the role's core mandatory requirements are not met: his professional C++ exposure is limited to roughly seven months at National Instruments (plus an academic project), not 5–10 years on Windows; his database depth is in MongoDB/MySQL rather than SQL Server or Oracle; and he has no fixed income, derivatives, or investment-banking domain experience, with only tangential fintech exposure at RIDE Capital. The gap between his profile (TypeScript/Node/DLang generalist) and this specialized capital-markets C++ position is too large to bridge in a consulting engagement expected to be productive quickly.
strengths: Broad senior-level engineering experience with low-latency, high-throughput systems (DLang, async I/O, fibers)
Strong software craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, pairing, DevOps tooling, plus proven communication via talks and workshops
Some fintech context from RIDE Capital and prior C/C++ work at National Instruments
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++, far short of the 5–10 year Windows C++ requirement
No fixed income, derivatives, or investment-banking/capital-markets domain experience
SQL background is MySQL/MongoDB, not SQL Server or Oracle at enterprise depth
